script:
Wei Daughter
I am a student. Originally, I had a happy family, but when I was 14, my father got heart disease and never came down from the operating table. My mother and I lost our support from then on. What I didn't expect was that a year later, my mother actually married Uncle Zhen (Director Zhen), who was my father's attending physician. I resented him deeply in my heart. It must be because his medical skills weren't good enough, otherwise how could he not save my father? I tore up the photos of Uncle Zhen and my mother. He doesn't deserve to stand with my mother. Only my father deserves my mother.
I knew this Uncle Zhen was scum. Not long after marrying my mother, he showed his true nature and started hitting my mother and me. My mother endured it only because he would pay my tuition, but I had to write IOUs for all that tuition. He said since I wasn't his biological daughter, accounts must be clear. He also forbade me from telling my mother, otherwise he would hit her harder.
In September 2017, I was accepted to medical school. I want to be the best heart doctor and never let my father's tragedy happen again. But school was starting and he still hadn't given me tuition. He hadn't been home for a long time either, supposedly because his mother was ill so he stayed at the hospital. I was really worried about how to get tuition. I could only go to the hospital to find him. As expected, he just scolded me and didn't give me money. When I came out of his office, I saw a pale but handsome young man walking back to his room carrying his own IV bottle. I went over to help him carry the IV bottle. He smiled and thanked me. His smile was so beautiful. That's how we met. His name is Bai Patient.
In October 2017, the school urged me again for tuition. I could only go to the hospital again. I passed Bai Patient's room and went in to see him. He seemed in poor spirits. He actually said he was being discharged. Originally, he was supposed to have heart transplant surgery last week, but it was cancelled and given to someone else. He couldn't be saved and could only go home to wait for death. I couldn't believe it. He's so young, so wonderful, and the first boy to make my heart flutter like this. Why would this happen? I comforted him for a long time and even took photos with him. Although he smiled, he seemed to have other things on his mind, but he just patted my head and told me not to ask anymore. I could only leave first and look for Uncle Zhen for tuition. He wasn't in his office, so I found him in his mother's room based on what other doctors said. This time he didn't refuse and gave me tuition.
On January 30, 2018, Uncle Zhen came home drunk, supposedly celebrating his promotion to director. I was awakened by him and my mother arguing at midnight. I heard them fighting. Uncle Zhen angrily scolded my mother: "You ungrateful thing, I provide you with food and drink, and even pay for your burden's schooling, yet you dare scold me." My mother also angrily questioned him: "What you just said about Xiao Wei's father's death being related to you - is that true?" I trembled all over as I continued listening. He said: "So what if it is? What can you do about it? Without me, you'd be drinking the northwest wind!" Then he slammed the door and left. I never imagined he actually killed my father. Our current situation is all thanks to him.
The next morning, when I left for school, I saw my stepfather's car in the residential parking lot. When he opened the car door and got out, I saw another woman in the car. I recognized that woman - she's Nurse Wang from the hospital. So he stayed out all night with another woman.
I decided to avenge my biological father! Since he could kill my father without anyone knowing, I could also kill him secretly for revenge! I want him to taste what it's like to die under a scalpel. This way, I won't have to pay back the debts either.
February 3rd, today he's on duty at the hospital. In the evening when there are few people at the hospital, if he died at home, my mother and I would be hard to clear of suspicion. After thinking it over, I felt the hospital would be least likely to make others suspect me. Someone like him might have other enemies too. I took a practice scalpel from school. Scalpels are common in hospitals, which would also reduce my suspicion.
[February 3rd - Night of the Incident]
20:00 - Took a taxi to Health Hospital, carrying the meal my mother made to deliver to Director Zhen.
20:40 - Arrived at Health Hospital. Saw Nurse Wang at the front desk. I didn't greet her, disliking this woman in my heart.
20:45 - I went to Director Zhen's office, handed him the food, went to the water dispenser to pour him water, and flicked strong sleeping powder hidden under my fingernails into the water. If I put it in the food, I'd be hard to escape suspicion. Putting it in water was better for getting away.
21:10 - Ke Accountant knocked and came in. Director Zhen told me to go home first as they had things to discuss. I originally wanted to watch him drink the water and then kill him with the scalpel. It seemed I'd have to wait and come back later. I had to leave the hospital.
21:15 - I went to a coffee shop near the hospital and sat waiting.
21:40 - I returned to Director Zhen's office. I saw him lying on the desk - my sleeping pills must have taken effect. I went over and touched him, but he didn't react. I quickly stabbed him once in the heart position, pulled out the knife, and hurried away.
21:50 - I went to the mall. I needed to find a restroom to clean the blood off the weapon. To avoid being too obvious, I browsed the mall for about half an hour.
22:25 - I went to the restroom, cleaned the scalpel, put it back in my bag, and went home.
acts_goal: Hide your identity as the real culprit, try not to hide the fact that you went to the scene.
